title: Color overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Give secondary colors a defined share so useful variety does not displace the identity’s recognizable core.
strategic_value: Red, black and white can remain the dominant Verizon reference while secondary colors support specific needs.
demonstration: The July 22, 2021 screenshot pairs a primary red, black and white palette with a narrow stack of secondary colors and a stated 15% maximum.
practical_value: Apply the secondary-color limit to the whole layout rather than treating the swatch display as a precise primary-color ratio.

content_islands.name: Title and scope
content_islands.spec: Set the white Color overview title and update date on a black banner, followed by the palette description.

content_islands.name: Palette proportions
content_islands.spec: Place the tall red, black and white fields across the main width and the compact secondary-color stack at right.

reference_purposes.Expression: Large red, black and white fields dominate the palette display.
reference_purposes.Application: The text identifies the three primary colors and separates a suite of secondary colors.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text says secondary colors must not occupy more than 15% of any layout.

ingredient.name: Secondary palette
ingredient.role: Support communication while preserving the dominant red, black and white identity.
ingredient.application: Keep secondary colors to no more than 15% of a layout.
ingredient.scope: Historical Color overview updated July 22, 2021. The source does not prescribe a numerical ratio among the three primary colors.
